name: Ketostar Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOSTAR CREAM

KETOSTAR CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETOSTAR CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETOSTAR CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETOSTAR CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETOSTAR CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETOSTAR CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOSTAR CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOSTAR CREAM Works

KETOSTAR CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOSTAR CREAM

Apply KETOSTAR CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETOSTAR CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETOSTAR CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDIDOX CREAM

CANDIDOX CREAM contains Ciclopirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas, inner thigh and characterised by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes) and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut and vagina), tinea (pityriasis) versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms or legs).

CANDIDOX CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CANDIDOX CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CANDIDOX CREAM are itchiness, mild burning sensation or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea corporis and tinea cruris

name: OCTAMOP FORTE 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET

OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis.

Psoriasis is a condition in which the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Vitiligo is a long-term condition in which pale white patches develop on any area of skin (commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases) due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

During OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET management, your doctor may advise you to wear special wrap-around sunglasses that totally block or absorb ultraviolet light, to avoid exposure of your skin and lips to sunlight for 8 hours after management, to wear protective clothing like hat or gloves to cover as much of your body as possible after management, and to use a sunscreen product having a protection factor of at least 15 (only after management).

OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, or photosensitivity diseases.

Before taking OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic, x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET should be taken in pregnancy only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the therapy. Breastfeeding should be avoided while taking OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET are itching, redness of the skin, and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET

It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light to manage:

Vitiligo
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET Works

In psoriasis, OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET is assumed to work by damaging the DNA on exposure to light, resulting in decreased cell multiplication, but other mechanisms may also be playing some role. In vitiligo, it has been suggested that melanocytes (cells containing the pigment called melanin) in the hair follicle are stimulated by OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET to move up the follicle and to repopulate the outermost layer of your skin.
usageDetails:
How to use OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET

Take OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide an appropriate dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.
sideEffects: Small growths on the skin or skin sores that will not heal

Small growths on the skin or skin sores that will not heal

warnings.details: OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Avoid breastfeeding while taking OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET as it is not known if this medicine passes into the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your physician before taking it.
Do not take OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET if you are allergic to Methoxsalen or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having heart or blood pressure problems. Consult your physician before taking it.

Others

OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye)
Have or had melanoma
Have invasive squamous cell carcinoma
Have photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum, erythropoietic protoporphyria, variegate porphyria, and albinism)

Before taking OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had multiple basal cell carcinoma
Had arsenic therapy
Recently had x-ray or Grenz ray therapy or are about to have one
Are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress
Have GI diseases
Have chronic infection
Have or had any eye problems like cataracts or loss of the lens of the eyes
Have any medical condition that requires you to stay out of the sun like lupus erythematosus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety of OCTAMOP FORTE 20 TABLET in children has not been established so, consult your child's doctor for advice.

LULIFIN MAX CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Ketocip Shampoo is used to manage dandruff and dry or greasy scalping of the scalp (seborrhoeic dermatitis). It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient to provide freedom from dandruff.

Klmite Soap is a medicated soap that is used for the management of scabies caused by the itch mite. It is also effective against human lice and against certain topical skin infections. It contains Permethrin and cetrimide as active ingredients.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

introduction:
Introduction About PHYTORAL B CREAM

PHYTORAL B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying PHYTORAL B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. PHYTORAL B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

PHYTORAL B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. PHYTORAL B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. PHYTORAL B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.

How PHYTORAL B CREAM Works

PHYTORAL B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.

Apply PHYTORAL B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About HEXAFUNG CREAM

HEXAFUNG CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

HEXAFUNG CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

HEXAFUNG CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using HEXAFUNG CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LLCOL LOTION

LLCOL LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LLCOL LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LLCOL LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LLCOL LOTION

LLCOL LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LLCOL LOTION Works

LLCOL LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LLCOL LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
